explanation: Generated the requested eta-channel single-point EXCLURAD input at W=1.7 GeV, Q2=1.0 GeV^2, cos(theta*)=0, phi*=90 deg, with vcut=-0.1 as requested. The kinematic point is within the documented eta production grid. Warning: in this eta fork, the README/examples say a negative vcut should impose a cut on v directly, but the Fortran source only limits vmax when cutv > 0 (see eta/exclurad.F lines 47, 115, 237-254). That means vcut=-0.1 likely will not apply the intended cut and may behave like no vcut at all when the code is run.
